title: P3530PW corn (Pioneer P3530PW): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P3530PW corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P3530PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. About 104 days to harvest, 6.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P3530PW corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P3530PW or P3530. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2024 as NSIC 2024 GMCn 96. Corteva Agriscience bred it. It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 6.06 tonnes per hectare in the trials (5.64 in Luzon, 6.48 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P3530PW or P3530, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P3530PW corn takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 6.06 t/ha trails the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 104 to 109 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 14.91 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 79.99 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** P3530PW: 5.64 t/ha Luzon, 6.48 Mindanao in NSIC trials, older P3530YHR: 7.65 Luzon, 8.36 Mindanao.

**Traits in the seed:** PowerCore (MON 89034 x TC1507 x NK603): three Bt proteins (Cry1A.105, Cry2Ab2, Cry1F) against corn borer, earworm, fall armyworm and other caterpillars, plus glyphosate (Roundup) tolerance, 95:5 refuge seed blend.
Shelling about 79 to 80 percent in NSIC trials.
Registry rates P3530YHR resistant to lodging, corn borer, rust, stalk rot and earworm.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: on BPI's Jan 2025 list of PowerCore hybrids cleared for sale. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant P3530PW corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P3530PW the same as P3530PW?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P3530PW is another name for P3530PW, registered as NSIC 2024 GMCn 96. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 104 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 6.06 tonnes per hectare in the trials (5.64 in Luzon, 6.48 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P3530PW?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
